title: Global War on Terrorism War Memorial Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

Global War on Terrorism War Memorial Act

(Sec. 2) This bill allows the Global War on Terror Memorial Foundation to establish the National Global War on Terrorism Memorial as a commemorative work on federal land in the District of Columbia to commemorate and honor the members of the Armed Forces who served on active duty in support of the Global War on Terrorism.

The memorial shall be established in accordance with the Commemorative Works Act.

The bill prohibits the use of federal funds to pay any expenses for the establishment of the memorial.

The Foundation shall be solely responsible for accepting contributions and paying expenses to establish the memorial.

If, upon payment of all expenses for the establishment of the memorial or upon the expiration of the legislative authority for the memorial, there remains a balance of funds that was received to establish it, the Foundation shall transmit such funds to the Department of the Interior for deposit into the National Park Foundation account.

summary.headline: Lets a private foundation build a national memorial in Washington, D.C., honoring service members who served in the Global War on Terrorism, using only private money.
summary.what_it_does: The law allows the Global War on Terror Memorial Foundation to establish a national memorial on federal land in the District of Columbia. The memorial must follow the Commemorative Works Act, which sets the rules for memorials in the capital. Federal money cannot be used for any memorial costs. The Foundation must raise the money, pay the expenses, and send any leftover funds to the National Park Foundation after the memorial is paid for or its legal authority expires.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Armed Forces who served on active duty in the Global War on Terrorism
who_it_affects.how: They are the group the memorial is meant to honor.

who_it_affects.group: The Global War on Terror Memorial Foundation
who_it_affects.how: It is given the authority to build the memorial and is solely responsible for raising and paying its costs.
It may receive any leftover memorial funds once the project is paid for or its authority ends.
Federal funds may not be used to pay the memorial's establishment expenses.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: Enacted August 18, 2017, with the memorial to be established under the terms of the act.
